items.heading: Trinxat
details: Key ingredients: cabbage, potatoes, bacon, garlic
Boil cabbage and potatoes together until very soft.
Mash the cabbage and potatoes coarsely with a fork.
Fry chopped bacon and garlic until crisp and fragrant.
Press the mash into a flat cake and pan-fry until crusted, then top with the bacon.

items.heading: Escudella
details: Key ingredients: meatballs, pasta, vegetables, beans, broth
Simmer a large pot of meat, bones and vegetables into a hearty broth.
Add beans and shape a large seasoned meatball to poach in the broth.
Cook short pasta directly in the broth until tender.
Serve the broth with pasta first, then the meats and vegetables as a second course.
